scope: Corollary 5.6 (Projected split induction) of the manuscript “Donovan's Conjecture over Algebraically Closed Fields” (preprints/Donovans-Conjecture-over-Algebraic-Closures-of-Prime-Fields-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 203 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 80d721e72d29a9bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let s be a p′-parameter and fix its rational class in a split Levi M as above. On characters in Ep(MF, s), the coordinates in E(HF, s) after split induction depend only on the coordinates in E(MF, s). On these coordinates the matrix is the nonnegative branching matrix of Proposition 5.5, iterated when several size-one factors are extracted. The assertion remains valid after a common central p-quotient.
